chars.RACHID: RACHID: a 27-year-old Moroccan man with short black curly hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with white drawstrings, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a 27-year-old Moroccan man with a neat fade haircut and a thin beard, wearing a black puffer jacket and a red beanie
chars.RECEPTIONIST: RECEPTIONIST: a Moroccan woman in her 30s wearing a teal blazer, a white hijab and round glasses

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: RACHID lies bored on a sofa in a modest Casablanca apartment living room in the afternoon, scrolling his phone, a framed old high-school class photo on the wall behind him, warm window light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: RACHID sits up surprised on the sofa staring at his phone; a floating video-call style bubble beside him shows KARIM smiling and waving, wrapped in his jacket

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: KARIM stands proudly on a snowy German city street with colorful old townhouses and a tram behind him, taking a happy selfie, breath visible in the cold air

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: RACHID walks fast and hopeful along a busy Casablanca boulevard with white colonial buildings and palm trees, determined smile, holding a folder under his arm

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: inside a small bright language-school office in Casablanca, the RECEPTIONIST behind a desk explains a price sheet with a polite smile while RACHID stands in front of the desk listening, his face starting to fall

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: RACHID stands outside on the sidewalk opening his empty wallet, only a few coins in his palm, worried frown, evening street lights of Casablanca

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: RACHID sits alone on the edge of his bed in a dim small bedroom at night, head in his hands, defeated, a weak lamp beside him

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: RACHID in his dark bedroom at night, lit by the glow of his phone screen, eyes widening with sudden hope, leaning toward the phone
